description: Pleasant Hill outdoor washroom faces $85,000 funding gap for 2025.
City will not fund navigation services for washroom users.

chips.text: Mayor Block expects washrooms to open quickly and remain open until October 31st.
Unhoused population of 1,500 people rely on public washrooms and water.
Is navigation needed at washrooms with nearby drop-in centers?
Jennifer Barrett advocated for outreach services, gender-neutral stalls, and more drinking water.
Transgender community faces higher homelessness rates, needs gender-neutral washrooms.
Administration will provide a broader washroom and water access strategy report later this year.

description: Saskatoon explores National Urban Park designation.
Public engagement begins July 2025.
Park designation targeted by March 2026.
Meewasin Valley Authority would lead park operations.

chips.text: Councillor raised concern about federal government commitment to partnership model.
Public entities like the City, Province, University, and Meewasin own included land.
Saskatoon is a model for new national urban park partnership approach.
Project includes Indigenous Cultural Spaces for cultural practices and revitalization.
A core objective is conserving nature and preserving the ecosystem.
A legally binding designation agreement will formalize the partnership.
